chapter: Split, hospital and decline of tap
title: Scat singing replaces tap and dancers take off their taps
summary: Green says dancers took their taps off, changed names and became characters, with scat singers like Ella Fitzgerald taking their place while big bands kept travelling.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now why do you think tap dancing was declining in the public appeal?

Because they -- actually they took their taps off, they wouldn't actually try to write the pages anymore of the art, you see, and it just got into -- they start becoming characters, you know. Quite a few of them, you know, like -- they changed their names, you understand. They just wasn't interested in the world tours, you see, like that what monarchy was known as -- many years ago, and they started to go and they'd go to what'd you call -- they was engulfing, I would say. In other words, we'll try something else, you know.
And what was taking tap dancing's place?
Singing. See? What they called scat,

the scat singing, they had Ella Fitzgerald, she scat sings. You know. Louis Williams, he scat sings. Timmy Rogers, he scat sings. See, cause that was Gardening Rogers, see they was great as tapdancers, one time, used to leap from the aisles, the theater aisles, over the pits, up on stage, -- who's discovery were they -- they were -- discovered by Blanche Calloway, I think and they used to play these drums, it was like tap dancing drummers, you see.
And what about big bands, were they beginning to take the --

Oh, now, well they was lucky -- big bands was on they own you see, because the big bands, had what they called ballrooms, see? And they could play in these ballrooms all over the world. They stayed in the monarchy. You see. But they travelled a lot, you see, they were in great demand, see, because people were more important, and you know. See. And there were more of them alive. You know.
Well didn't they continue to have tap dancers with them?
Yeah, but the tap dancers wouldn't wear the taps, anymore, they took them off.
